title: Quanta Probe
subtitle: Real RSC stream capture, parser, and cross-surface fan-out

whatIs.heading: What is Probe?
whatIs.body: Probe is the RSC capture system inside the IDE. It fetches a Next.js route's React Flight payload, parses each chunk, and shares the analysis with every panel that knows how to read it — without you opening 6 different overlays.

howTo.heading: How to capture
howTo.step2: Switch to Live, paste a route URL (e.g. /__rsc/products/walnut-table)
howTo.step3: Click Fetch — every surface listed below updates automatically

roadmap.heading: What's next (roadmap)
roadmap.autoAttach: Auto-attach loader so the IDE injects Probe into your next dev process automatically
roadmap.ws: WebSocket push: capture every page navigation in real time, with source maps
roadmap.ci: CI mode: batch-capture all routes, post bundle delta to PR
